approach: the global --format <toon|json|text> joins the base command, active under output axi or when cli({ format }) is set, so the default console output with no cli({ format }) is unchanged (axi-native RFC section 3.4, step 6 of section 6)
the resolved value is this.format in run(), the usage-error context's format, and the format a CliError is rendered in under output axi
a bad --format value is a usage error on the global key, code invalid-value with the allowed formats, and the format falls back to the cli's default so it cannot loop
a command's own format option is a startup error while the global option is active; the plugins builtins in core and @clibuilder/plugins mark theirs as giving way and read this.format
scenarios added to the frozen execution and builtin-commands suites and to the plugins extension suite; no existing scenario changed
